items.q: What kind of technology challenges do you help solve?
items.a: I work with teams on solution architecture, full-stack platforms, enterprise integrations (SAP, Kafka, Azure), and AI-assisted automation—bridging technical complexity with business delivery.

items.q: Do you collaborate with existing product and engineering teams?
items.a: Yes. I integrate with existing technical teams, helping untangle architecture bottlenecks, establishing clear contracts, and aligning system decisions with strategic delivery milestones.

items.q: Which technologies and platforms are in your core stack?
items.a: My core stack includes Node.js, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Azure Cloud, AWS, Apache Kafka, REST/GraphQL APIs, SAP ERP integration, and Kubernetes container runtimes.

items.q: Can you help assess and modernize a legacy enterprise system?
items.a: Yes. I conduct architecture health audits, isolate brittle dependencies, and design incremental strangler-fig migration paths that modernize services with zero production downtime.

items.q: Are you based in Dubai and available for regional or remote engagements?
items.a: Yes. I am based in Dubai, UAE, with extensive experience delivering platforms across nine Middle Eastern and international markets.
